source.title: 4 Breakout Tight Ends to Target
source.author: Lawrence Iacona
source.summary: Four tight ends with expanding usage, favorable environments, or high-end efficiency.

takeaways.label: breakout
takeaways.summary: Strange's 2025 foundation and potential target-share growth give him a path to consistent TE1 production.
takeaways.rationale: Strange's 2025 foundation and potential target-share growth give him a path to consistent TE1 production.
risks: He was only Jacksonville's fourth passing option last season.

takeaways.label: breakout
takeaways.summary: Barner's reliable 2025 receiving line and Seattle's early backfield uncertainty could increase passing and red-zone opportunity.
takeaways.rationale: Barner's reliable 2025 receiving line and Seattle's early backfield uncertainty could increase passing and red-zone opportunity.
risks: The projected passing shift and red-zone growth are assumptions.

takeaways.label: breakout
takeaways.summary: Helm's contested-catch and red-zone traits create touchdown upside as Tennessee modernizes its passing game.
takeaways.rationale: Helm's contested-catch and red-zone traits create touchdown upside as Tennessee modernizes its passing game.
risks: His rookie volume was modest and Cam Ward must improve.

takeaways.label: breakout
takeaways.summary: Kraft's elite pre-injury pace and central Green Bay role give him top-five tight-end potential when healthy.
takeaways.rationale: Kraft's elite pre-injury pace and central Green Bay role give him top-five tight-end potential when healthy.
risks: The case depends on a durable return from his Week 9 injury.
